title: Swahili Chicken Soup
community: Swahili coast — the coastal healing chicken soup
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Swahili Chicken Soup — chicken simmered with Zanzibar whole spices, coconut milk, lemon grass, and coriander. More aromatic than plain chicken soup, more restorative, and carrying the full Swahili coast flavour signature.
longDesc: Swahili chicken soup takes the simplest preparation — chicken in broth — and elevates it with the coastal spice palette. The lemon grass, cardamom, and cloves transform it into something uniquely Tanzanian coastal.
steps: Simmer chicken with water, onion, garlic, ginger, lemon grass, and all whole spices for 40 minutes.
Remove chicken. Shred. Discard lemon grass and whole spices.
Add coconut milk to broth. Simmer gently 8 minutes.
Season. Garnish with coriander. Serve with lime.
chefTips: Discard lemon grass — it is woody and unpleasant to eat.
Never boil after adding coconut milk.
cookingScience: See TZA044 for coconut chicken soup science.
culturalNote: Swahili chicken soup is the food of coastal recovery — given to the sick, the recovering, and the newborn. The whole spices of Zanzibar make it one of the most healing soups in East Africa.
